tiles.title: Delivered emails moved after delivery (ZAP / remediation)
Threat emails over time by threat type
Threats by delivery action and location
BEC financial / urgency lures from external senders
Display-name impersonation of internal users / VIPs
Email authentication failures (SPF / DKIM / DMARC / CompAuth)
Look-alike / cousin domains of your domains
First-contact sender domains (not seen in previous 14 days)
AiTM kill chain per user: phish -> click -> new-IP sign-in -> mailbox change
Users with malicious URL click alerts
AiTM / credential-theft / BEC alerts with impacted entities
Top malicious URL domains in email
Users who clicked malicious or suspicious links
Malicious URL click alerts over time
URL shorteners and redirect services in delivered mail
Risky attachment types delivered (HTML smuggling, SVG, ISO, LNK...)
Malware detected in SharePoint / OneDrive / Teams files
Post-delivery moves by destination and trigger
Delivered threats NOT remediated (still in mailbox)
OAuth consent and app permission grants
Email & identity alerts by category and severity

Executive display names for impersonation detection, e.g. jane doe, john smith

queries.text:
set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let PostDel = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| extend P0 = pack_all()
| extend LatestLocation = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryLocation), LatestAction = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryAction)
| where isnotempty(LatestLocation) and LatestLocation != DeliveryLocation
| project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, ThreatTypes, DeliveryLocation = LatestLocation,
          Action = LatestAction, ActionType = strcat("Moved to ", LatestLocation), ActionResult = "Success", ActionTrigger = iff(isnotempty(ThreatTypes), "ZAP / threat remediation", "Admin or user move");
PostDel
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where ActionResult =~ "Success"
| summarize Removals = count()

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let PostDel = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| extend P0 = pack_all()
| extend LatestLocation = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryLocation), LatestAction = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryAction)
| where isnotempty(LatestLocation) and LatestLocation != DeliveryLocation
| project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, ThreatTypes, DeliveryLocation = LatestLocation,
          Action = LatestAction, ActionType = strcat("Moved to ", LatestLocation), ActionResult = "Success", ActionTrigger = iff(isnotempty(ThreatTypes), "ZAP / threat remediation", "Admin or user move");
let ClickAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Title has_any ("malicious URL click", "URL click", "clicked a", "user clicked")
| project AlertId;
let ClickEv = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where AlertId in (ClickAlerts)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend EvUpn = tostring(P.AccountUpn), EvUrl = tostring(P.Url), EvIp = tostring(P.RemoteIP), EvMsg = tostring(P.NetworkMessageId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), AccountUpn = take_anyif(EvUpn, isnotempty(EvUpn)), Url = take_anyif(EvUrl, isnotempty(EvUrl)),
            IPAddress = take_anyif(EvIp, isnotempty(EvIp)), NetworkMessageId = take_anyif(EvMsg, isnotempty(EvMsg)) by AlertId
| extend ActionType = "ClickAllowed", ThreatTypes = "Phish", IsClickedThrough = false, Workload = "Email";
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
| project NetworkMessageId, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction, EmailDirection;
let M = materialize(Mail);
let PD = PostDel
| where ActionResult =~ "Success"
| distinct NetworkMessageId;
let Clk = ClickEv
| where ActionType == "ClickAllowed"
| distinct NetworkMessageId;
union
 (M | where EmailDirection == "Inbound" | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "1. Inbound emails"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "2. Threat detected"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction != "Delivered" | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "3. Blocked / junked at delivery"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction == "Delivered" | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "4. Threat delivered"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and NetworkMessageId in (PD) | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "5. Removed post-delivery"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and NetworkMessageId !in (PD) | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "6. Still in mailbox"),
 (M | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and NetworkMessageId in (Clk) | summarize Count = count() | extend Stage = "7. Threat link clicked (allowed)")
| project Stage, Count
| order by Stage asc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
;
Mail
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and isnotempty(tostring(DetectionMethods))
| project DM = todynamic(tostring(DetectionMethods))
| mv-expand DM
| extend Threat = tostring(bag_keys(DM)[0])
| mv-expand Method = DM[Threat] to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Method)
| summarize Emails = count() by Technique = strcat(Threat, ": ", Method)
| top 15 by Emails

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);

| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Title has_any ("malicious URL click", "URL click", "clicked a", "user clicked")
| project AlertId;

| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where AlertId in (ClickAlerts)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend EvUpn = tostring(P.AccountUpn), EvUrl = tostring(P.Url), EvIp = tostring(P.RemoteIP), EvMsg = tostring(P.NetworkMessageId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), AccountUpn = take_anyif(EvUpn, isnotempty(EvUpn)), Url = take_anyif(EvUrl, isnotempty(EvUrl)),
            IPAddress = take_anyif(EvIp, isnotempty(EvIp)), NetworkMessageId = take_anyif(EvMsg, isnotempty(EvMsg)) by AlertId

let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
;
let RiskyClicks = ClickEv
| where (ActionType == "ClickAllowed" and isnotempty(ThreatTypes)) or tostring(IsClickedThrough) in~ ("true", "1")
| summarize RiskyClicks = count() by Recipient = tolower(AccountUpn);
Mail
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize Threats = count(), Phish = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"), Malware = countif(ThreatTypes has "Malware"),
            Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"), Senders = dcount(SenderFromAddress), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Recipient = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress)
| join kind=leftouter RiskyClicks on Recipient
| extend RiskyClicks = coalesce(RiskyClicks, long(0))
| extend Severity = case(RiskyClicks > 0 and Delivered > 0, "1-High (delivered + clicked)", Delivered > 0, "2-Medium (threat delivered)", "3-Low (blocked)")
| project Severity, Recipient, Threats, Phish, Malware, Delivered, RiskyClicks, Senders, LastSeen
| order by Severity asc, Threats desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
| extend A = todynamic(tostring(AuthenticationDetails))
| extend SPF = tostring(A.SPF), DKIM = tostring(A.DKIM), DMARC = tostring(A.DMARC), CompAuth = tostring(A.CompAuth)

;

            AuthFails = countif(AuthFail), ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatTypes, 5), SenderIPs = make_set(SenderIPv4, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SenderFromDomain
| order by Delivered desc, Threats desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
| extend A = todynamic(tostring(AuthenticationDetails))
| extend SPF = tostring(A.SPF), DKIM = tostring(A.DKIM), DMARC = tostring(A.DMARC), CompAuth = tostring(A.CompAuth)
| extend AuthFail = DMARC =~ "fail" or SPF in~ ("fail", "softfail") or CompAuth =~ "fail"
;
Mail
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and AuthFail
| summarize Emails = count(), Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
            SPFFail = countif(SPF in~ ("fail", "softfail")), DKIMFail = countif(DKIM =~ "fail"), DMARCFail = countif(DMARC =~ "fail"),
            CompAuthFail = countif(CompAuth =~ "fail"), Threats = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)), Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5)
    by SenderFromDomain
| extend Severity = case(Delivered > 0 and DMARCFail > 0, "1-High (DMARC fail delivered)", Delivered > 0, "2-Medium (auth fail delivered)", "3-Low")
| project Severity, SenderFromDomain, Emails, Delivered, Recipients, SPFFail, DKIMFail, DMARCFail, CompAuthFail, Threats, Subjects
| order by Severity asc, Delivered desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
;
let InternalDomains = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _endTime)
| where EmailDirection in ("Outbound", "Intra-org")
| distinct SenderFromDomain;
let Norm = (s:string) { replace_string(replace_string(translate("0135$@", "olessa", tolower(s)), "rn", "m"), "vv", "w") };
let Roots = InternalDomains
| extend Root = tolower(tostring(split(SenderFromDomain, ".")[0]))
| where strlen(Root) >= 4
| distinct Root
| extend RootN = Norm(Root), K = 1;
Mail
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and SenderFromDomain !in (InternalDomains)
| summarize Emails = count(), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            Threats = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)), Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by SenderFromDomain
| extend SRoot = tolower(tostring(split(SenderFromDomain, ".")[0])), K = 1
| extend SRootN = Norm(SRoot)
| join kind=inner Roots on K
| where SRootN == RootN or (SRoot != Root and indexof(SRoot, Root) >= 0)
| extend Technique = iff(SRootN == RootN and SRoot != Root, "Homoglyph (0/o, 1/l, rn/m)", iff(SRoot == Root, "Same name, different TLD", "Brand inside domain"))
| extend Severity = case(Delivered > 0, "1-High (delivered)", "2-Medium")
| project Severity, SenderFromDomain, ImpersonatedRoot = Root, Technique, Emails, Recipients, Delivered, Threats, Subjects, FirstSeen
| order by Severity asc, Emails desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
;
let InternalDomains = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _endTime)
| where EmailDirection in ("Outbound", "Intra-org")
| distinct SenderFromDomain;
let Seen = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _startTime)
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| distinct SenderFromDomain;
Mail
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and SenderFromDomain !in (InternalDomains) and SenderFromDomain !in (Seen)
| extend A = todynamic(tostring(AuthenticationDetails))
| extend SPF = tostring(A.SPF), DKIM = tostring(A.DKIM), DMARC = tostring(A.DMARC), CompAuth = tostring(A.CompAuth)
| extend AuthFail = DMARC =~ "fail" or SPF in~ ("fail", "softfail") or CompAuth =~ "fail"
| summarize Emails = count(), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            Threats = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)), AuthFails = countif(AuthFail), Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by SenderFromDomain
| extend Severity = case(Delivered > 0 and (AuthFails > 0 or Threats > 0), "1-High", Recipients >= 5, "2-Medium (broad first contact)", "3-Low")
| project Severity, SenderFromDomain, Emails, Recipients, Delivered, Threats, AuthFails, Subjects, FirstSeen
| order by Severity asc, Recipients desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Days = max_of((_endTime - _startTime) / 1d, 1.0);
let Out = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _endTime)
| where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
| where isempty(_recipient) or SenderFromAddress =~ _recipient
| project TimeGenerated, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, ThreatTypes, Subject;
let Base = Out | where TimeGenerated < _startTime | summarize BaseDaily = count() / 14.0 by SenderFromAddress;
Out
| where TimeGenerated >= _startTime
| summarize Sent = count(), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), OutboundThreats = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)),
            ThreatSubjects = make_set_if(Subject, isnotempty(ThreatTypes), 5) by SenderFromAddress
| join kind=leftouter Base on SenderFromAddress
| extend BaseDaily = round(coalesce(BaseDaily, 0.0), 1), CurrentDaily = round(Sent / Days, 1)
| extend SpikeRatio = round(CurrentDaily / max_of(BaseDaily, 1.0), 1)
| extend Severity = case(OutboundThreats > 0, "1-High (outbound threat detected)", SpikeRatio >= 5 and Sent >= 20, "2-Medium (volume spike)", "3-Low")
| project Severity, SenderFromAddress, Sent, Recipients, CurrentDaily, BaseDaily, SpikeRatio, OutboundThreats, ThreatSubjects
| order by Severity asc, SpikeRatio desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let ClickAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Title has_any ("malicious URL click", "URL click", "clicked a", "user clicked")
| project AlertId;
let ClickEv = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where AlertId in (ClickAlerts)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend EvUpn = tostring(P.AccountUpn), EvUrl = tostring(P.Url), EvIp = tostring(P.RemoteIP), EvMsg = tostring(P.NetworkMessageId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), AccountUpn = take_anyif(EvUpn, isnotempty(EvUpn)), Url = take_anyif(EvUrl, isnotempty(EvUrl)),
            IPAddress = take_anyif(EvIp, isnotempty(EvIp)), NetworkMessageId = take_anyif(EvMsg, isnotempty(EvMsg)) by AlertId
| extend ActionType = "ClickAllowed", ThreatTypes = "Phish", IsClickedThrough = false, Workload = "Email";
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
;
let Clicks = ClickEv
| where isempty(_recipient) or AccountUpn =~ _recipient
| extend ClickedThrough = tostring(IsClickedThrough) in~ ("true", "1");
let Window = 4h;
let PhishIds = Mail | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) | distinct NetworkMessageId;
let PhishD = Mail
| where ThreatTypes has "Phish" and DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| summarize PhishDelivered = count(), FirstPhish = min(TimeGenerated), PhishSubjects = make_set(Subject, 5), PhishSenders = make_set(SenderFromAddress, 5)
    by User = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress);
let RiskClicks = Clicks
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) or ClickedThrough or NetworkMessageId in (PhishIds)
| where ActionType == "ClickAllowed" or ClickedThrough
| summarize RiskyClicks = count(), FirstClick = min(TimeGenerated), ClickIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5), Urls = make_set(Url, 5)
    by User = tolower(AccountUpn);
let Exposed = materialize(PhishD
| join kind=fullouter RiskClicks on User
| extend User = coalesce(User, User1)
| where isnotempty(User)
| extend Exposure = min_of(coalesce(FirstPhish, datetime(2100-01-01)), coalesce(FirstClick, datetime(2100-01-01)))
| project-away User1);
let ExUsers = Exposed | project User;
let Base = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _startTime)
   | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) in (ExUsers)
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _startTime)
   | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) in (ExUsers)
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName)
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName), IPAddress;
let NewIP = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. (_endTime + Window))
   | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) in (ExUsers)
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. (_endTime + Window))
   | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) in (ExUsers)
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName)
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend User = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=leftanti Base on User, IPAddress;
let SignAfter = Exposed
| project User, Exposure
| join kind=inner NewIP on User
| where TimeGenerated between (Exposure .. (Exposure + Window))
| summarize NewIPSignins = count(), SigninIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5), Countries = make_set(Location, 5), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5), FirstNewSignin = min(TimeGenerated) by User;
let Mbx = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. (_endTime + Window))
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules","Set-Mailbox","Add-MailboxPermission","Set-TransportRule","New-TransportRule")
| extend User = tolower(tostring(todynamic(tostring(RawEventData)).UserId))
| summarize MailboxChanges = count(), MailboxActions = make_set(ActionType, 5) by User;
Exposed
| join kind=leftouter SignAfter on User
| join kind=leftouter Mbx on User
| extend PhishDelivered = coalesce(PhishDelivered, long(0)), RiskyClicks = coalesce(RiskyClicks, long(0)), NewIPSignins = coalesce(NewIPSignins, long(0)), MailboxChanges = coalesce(MailboxChanges, long(0))
| extend Severity = case(RiskyClicks > 0 and NewIPSignins > 0 and MailboxChanges > 0, "1-Critical (full AiTM chain)",
                         RiskyClicks > 0 and NewIPSignins > 0, "2-High (click + new-IP sign-in)",
                         NewIPSignins > 0, "3-Medium (exposure + new-IP sign-in)",
                         RiskyClicks > 0, "4-Medium (risky click)", "5-Low (phish delivered)")
| project Severity, User, PhishDelivered, RiskyClicks, NewIPSignins, MailboxChanges, Exposure, FirstClick, FirstNewSignin,
          ClickIPs, SigninIPs, Countries, Apps, MailboxActions, PhishSubjects, PhishSenders, Urls
| order by Severity asc, Exposure desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let ClickAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Title has_any ("malicious URL click", "URL click", "clicked a", "user clicked")
| project AlertId;
let ClickEv = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where AlertId in (ClickAlerts)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend EvUpn = tostring(P.AccountUpn), EvUrl = tostring(P.Url), EvIp = tostring(P.RemoteIP), EvMsg = tostring(P.NetworkMessageId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), AccountUpn = take_anyif(EvUpn, isnotempty(EvUpn)), Url = take_anyif(EvUrl, isnotempty(EvUrl)),
            IPAddress = take_anyif(EvIp, isnotempty(EvIp)), NetworkMessageId = take_anyif(EvMsg, isnotempty(EvMsg)) by AlertId
| extend ActionType = "ClickAllowed", ThreatTypes = "Phish", IsClickedThrough = false, Workload = "Email";
let Mail = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_recipient) or RecipientEmailAddress =~ _recipient
| where isempty(_senderDomain) or SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain
| project NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, DeliveryAction, ThreatTypes, EmailDirection;
let Pattern = @"(?i)(login|log-in|signin|sign-in|verify|validate|sso|oauth|auth|password|passwd|mfa|2fa|secure|account|o365|office|microsoft|m365|outlook|sharepoint|onedrive|docusign|adobe|wetransfer)";
let Hosting = dynamic(["workers.dev","pages.dev","ipfs","ngrok","glitch.me","firebaseapp.com","web.app","r2.dev","azurewebsites.net","blob.core.windows.net","github.io","netlify.app","vercel.app","weebly","wixsite","square.site","replit","onrender.com","herokuapp.com","trycloudflare.com"]);
let Legit = dynamic(["microsoft.com","microsoftonline.com","office.com","office365.com","live.com","outlook.com","sharepoint.com","microsoft365.com","aka.ms","windows.net","azure.com","safelinks.protection.outlook.com"]);
let ClickedUrls = ClickEv
| summarize Clicks = count(), Allowed = countif(ActionType == "ClickAllowed"), Clickers = strcat_array(make_set(AccountUpn, 10), ", ") by Url;
external_table('EmailUrlInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain = tolower(UrlDomain)
| join kind=inner (Mail | where EmailDirection == "Inbound") on NetworkMessageId
| where not(UrlDomain has_any (Legit))
| extend KeywordHit = Url matches regex Pattern, HostingHit = UrlDomain has_any (Hosting)
| where KeywordHit or HostingHit or isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| join kind=leftouter ClickedUrls on Url
| summarize Emails = dcount(NetworkMessageId), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Delivered = dcountif(NetworkMessageId, DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            Flagged = dcountif(NetworkMessageId, isnotempty(ThreatTypes)), AllowedClicks = sum(Allowed),
            KeywordHit = max(toint(KeywordHit)), HostingHit = max(toint(HostingHit)), SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 3), Clickers = make_set_if(Clickers, isnotempty(Clickers), 10)
    by UrlDomain
| extend Severity = case(AllowedClicks > 0 and Delivered > 0, "1-High (delivered + clicked)", Delivered > 0 and Flagged == 0 and (HostingHit == 1 or KeywordHit == 1), "2-Medium (delivered, not flagged)", Delivered > 0, "3-Medium", "4-Low (blocked)")
| project Severity, UrlDomain, Emails, Recipients, Delivered, Flagged, AllowedClicks, KeywordHit, HostingHit, SampleUrls, Clickers
| order by Severity asc, AllowedClicks desc, Delivered desc
| take 50

| extend LatestLocation = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryLocation), LatestAction = tostring(P0.LatestDeliveryAction)
| where isnotempty(LatestLocation) and LatestLocation != DeliveryLocation
| project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, ThreatTypes, DeliveryLocation = LatestLocation,
          Action = LatestAction, ActionType = strcat("Moved to ", LatestLocation), ActionResult = "Success", ActionTrigger = iff(isnotempty(ThreatTypes), "ZAP / threat remediation", "Admin or user move");
let ClickAlerts = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Title has_any ("malicious URL click", "URL click", "clicked a", "user clicked")
| project AlertId;
let ClickEv = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where AlertId in (ClickAlerts)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend EvUpn = tostring(P.AccountUpn), EvUrl = tostring(P.Url), EvIp = tostring(P.RemoteIP), EvMsg = tostring(P.NetworkMessageId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), AccountUpn = take_anyif(EvUpn, isnotempty(EvUpn)), Url = take_anyif(EvUrl, isnotempty(EvUrl)),
            IPAddress = take_anyif(EvIp, isnotempty(EvIp)), NetworkMessageId = take_anyif(EvMsg, isnotempty(EvMsg)) by AlertId
| extend ActionType = "ClickAllowed", ThreatTypes = "Phish", IsClickedThrough = false, Workload = "Email";
let U = tolower(_recipient);
let Email = external_table('EmailEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where (isnotempty(U) and RecipientEmailAddress =~ U) or (isnotempty(_senderDomain) and SenderFromDomain =~ _senderDomain)
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "Email", User = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress), Activity = strcat(DeliveryAction, " / ", DeliveryLocation),
          Detail = strcat(SenderFromAddress, " | ", Subject), Threat = ThreatTypes, IP = SenderIPv4;
let Click = ClickEv
| where isnotempty(U) and AccountUpn =~ U
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClick", User = tolower(AccountUpn), Activity = ActionType, Detail = Url, Threat = ThreatTypes, IP = IPAddress;
let Post = PostDel
| where isnotempty(U) and RecipientEmailAddress =~ U
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "PostDelivery", User = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress), Activity = strcat(ActionType, " / ", ActionResult), Detail = Action, Threat = ThreatTypes, IP = "";
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isnotempty(U) and UserPrincipalName =~ U
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isnotempty(U) and UserPrincipalName =~ U
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName)
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "SignIn", User = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Activity = iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", strcat("Failure ", ResultType)), Detail = AppDisplayName, Threat = "", IP = IPAddress;
let Cloud = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(U)
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules", "Set-Mailbox", "Add-MailboxPermission", "MailItemsAccessed", "Send", "SoftDelete", "HardDelete") or ActionType has "Consent"
| extend R = todynamic(tostring(RawEventData))
| where tostring(R.UserId) =~ U
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudApp", User = U, Activity = ActionType, Detail = tostring(R.Parameters), Threat = "", IP = IPAddress;
let Alert = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(U)
| extend P = pack_all()
| where tostring(P.AccountUpn) =~ U
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated) by AlertId
| join kind=inner (external_table('AlertInfo') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | project AlertId, Title, Severity) on AlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "Alert", User = U, Activity = Severity, Detail = Title, Threat = "", IP = "";
union Email, Click, Post, Sign, Cloud, Alert
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
